comment: Ca junk payloads for the round-79 S884 census-drift correction. Honest payload first for contrast; J-CA1..J-CA6 are the exact false payloads. Tokens measured from committed bytes at 4b255745dea45a45d88b17e3c3fea4cdb6700cf7 on 2026-10-30.

junk.name: J-CA1
junk.why_false: Swaps the two tokens: asserts the registry (old) was amend-2026-10-23 and the actual truth is the receipt's amend-2026-10-24-r13. amend-2026-10-24-r13.md never existed for this entry (exact-path git log across all refs is empty). Every field is present and well-formed, so a presence-only checker passes it; ACTUAL-TOKEN leg must fail it.

junk.name: J-CA2
junk.why_false: Claims the receipt token was old and the corrected truth equals it — i.e. the registry should have said 24-r13 all along. ACTUAL-TOKEN leg must fail (registry at the measured revision says 10-23).

junk.name: J-CA3
junk.why_false: A one-line note naming S884 and the receipt with no digest, no revision, no tokens. A presence-only grep for 'S884' + 'correction' passes it; every binding leg must fail it for missing fields.

junk.name: J-CA4
junk.why_false: Truncated 7-hex digest (the round-73 freeze-hash mistake class). All other fields are honest. RECEIPT-DIGEST leg must fail; presence-only sees a non-empty digest field and passes.

junk.name: J-CA5
junk.why_false: Binds the lane base 44f76d45... instead of the receipt's own commit 4b255745... All tokens/digests honest. REVISION leg must fail (the drift must be measured at the revision the receipt actually records).

junk.name: J-CA6
junk.why_false: Fixture edits the drifted line 33 of census-end.txt in place at --lands (24-r13 -> 10-23) so the receipt reads clean, then any digest is moot. RECEIPT-UNCHANGED leg must fail: historical receipts are append-only and the drift is repaired by a correction record, never by rewriting the receipt.
